summary: Preinstall dropper fetches Bun runtime and executes an obfuscated undeclared bundle
details: @onereach/si-switch is published as a Vue UI component but ships a preinstall hook that runs setup.mjs, an obfuscator.io-mangled script. setup.mjs detects platform, architecture, and musl/Alpine, downloads a Bun runtime zip from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases into an OS tmpdir, extracts it, chmods the binary, and execFileSyncs it against a sibling file math_init.js. math_init.js is a 727KB `// @bun @bun-cjs` bundle transformed with obfuscator.io (numeric/string constant array, rotator, and char-code decoder), so its network destinations, filesystem paths, and API calls are not statically recoverable. math_init.js is not listed in package.json `files` (which declares only `lib/*`), so the payload is smuggled into the tarball outside the declared publish surface. A Vue component has no legitimate need to fetch a separate language runtime and execute an opaque bundle under it at install time; the alternate-runtime execution path also bypasses Node-based static and runtime scanners.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
